messages.content: Predict this participant's actual amount choice in a one-shot Trust Game. Previously, six participants waited around a shared table for about 20 minutes, with individual breaks for consent and general information. They could choose whether to talk to others. They were then randomly and anonymously matched into three pairs within this group and randomly assigned Investor or Reciprocator roles. Each person plays once, without repeated interactions. The Investor starts with $5 and chooses an amount S from $0 through $5 to send. The experimenter triples S, so the Reciprocator receives $3 times S. The Reciprocator knows the actual amount received and chooses an amount R from $0 through $3 times S to return. Returned money is not tripled again. Final game earnings are $(5-S+R) for the Investor and $(3 times S-R) for the Reciprocator, paid in cash at the end of the study. Anonymous matching does not identify your particular partner; knowing things about people in the waiting room does not identify that partner. Reply only with the dollar amount you will send or return in the current role. Decimals are allowed. Do not add a currency sign, units or reasons.

Predict this participant's actual amount choice in a one-shot Trust Game. Previously, six participants waited around a shared table for about 20 minutes, with individual breaks for consent and general information. They could choose whether to talk to others. They were then randomly and anonymously matched into three pairs within this group and randomly assigned Investor or Reciprocator roles. Each person plays once, without repeated interactions. The Investor starts with $5 and chooses an amount S from $0 through $5 to send. The experimenter triples S, so the Reciprocator receives $3 times S. The Reciprocator knows the actual amount received and chooses an amount R from $0 through $3 times S to return. Returned money is not tripled again. Final game earnings are $(5-S+R) for the Investor and $(3 times S-R) for the Reciprocator, paid in cash at the end of the study. Anonymous matching does not identify your particular partner; knowing things about people in the waiting room does not identify that partner. Reply only with the dollar amount you will send or return in the current role. Decimals are allowed. Do not add a currency sign, units or reasons.

Predict this participant's actual amount choice in a one-shot Trust Game. Previously, six participants waited around a shared table for about 20 minutes, with individual breaks for consent and general information. They could choose whether to talk to others. They were then randomly and anonymously matched into three pairs within this group and randomly assigned Investor or Reciprocator roles. Each person plays once, without repeated interactions. The Investor starts with $5 and chooses an amount S from $0 through $5 to send. The experimenter triples S, so the Reciprocator receives $3 times S. The Reciprocator knows the actual amount received and chooses an amount R from $0 through $3 times S to return. Returned money is not tripled again. Final game earnings are $(5-S+R) for the Investor and $(3 times S-R) for the Reciprocator, paid in cash at the end of the study. Anonymous matching does not identify your particular partner; knowing things about people in the waiting room does not identify that partner. Reply only with the dollar amount you will send or return in the current role. Decimals are allowed. Do not add a currency sign, units or reasons.

Predict this participant's actual amount choice in a one-shot Trust Game. Previously, six participants waited around a shared table for about 20 minutes, with individual breaks for consent and general information. They could choose whether to talk to others. They were then randomly and anonymously matched into three pairs within this group and randomly assigned Investor or Reciprocator roles. Each person plays once, without repeated interactions. The Investor starts with $5 and chooses an amount S from $0 through $5 to send. The experimenter triples S, so the Reciprocator receives $3 times S. The Reciprocator knows the actual amount received and chooses an amount R from $0 through $3 times S to return. Returned money is not tripled again. Final game earnings are $(5-S+R) for the Investor and $(3 times S-R) for the Reciprocator, paid in cash at the end of the study. Anonymous matching does not identify your particular partner; knowing things about people in the waiting room does not identify that partner. Reply only with the dollar amount you will send or return in the current role. Decimals are allowed. Do not add a currency sign, units or reasons.
